newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SOCCER-SPARTAK MOSCOW KEEP 100 PERCENT RECORD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPARTAK MOSCOW KEEP 100 PERCENT RECORD.

text.p: Spartak Moscow made light of a floodlights failure which temporarily halted play to demolish city rivals Torpedo Moscow 3-0 on Wednesday and stay top of the Russian premier league.

Captain Ilya Tsymbalar set the champions on the way with a spectacular curling free-kick into the top corner of the net in the 32nd minute. Valery Kechinov added the other goals in the 39th and 63rd minutes.
Spartak have a 100 percent record after three matches.

Krylya Sovietov Samara beat Dynamo Moscow 1-0 to keep the league's only other 100 percent record. A 15-minute strike by Georgian Mamuka Minashvili was enough to keep them level on points with Spartak but second on goal difference.
Alania Vladikavkaz, last year's runners-up, suffered a surprise 2-0 defeat at home to Zenit St Petersburg, missing two penalties in front of a crowd of 42,000.
Alania's Ukrainian-born striker Ivan Getsko, newly signed from Lokomotiv Nizhny Novgorod, shot wide from the spot in the first half and Yuri Moroz's penalty was saved in the second.
